package: ICC Plus Local rc17 sparse-authoring release candidate
candidate_role: LLM-first ICC Plus 2.10.15 authoring, validation, and sparse saved-project serialization with an explicit authoring round-trip invariant

local_regression.normal_tests: CI workflow is authoritative for the current branch
local_regression.checked_in_examples: CI workflow is authoritative for the current branch

project_integrity.canonical_writes: hydrate and complete-validate in memory, then save the pinned sparse representation by default
project_integrity.compatibility_validation: normal saved-project validation is project validate; use --complete for explicit Creator completeness
project_integrity.identity_policy: hydration never invents missing entity identities; sparse project saves retain stable authoring identities such as Score idx
project_integrity.authoring_round_trip: canonical sparse saves must preserve non-derivable authoring state needed by later ICC Plus Local commands, including Sound Effect name
project_integrity.version_policy: older supported projects may upgrade to 2.10.15; future versions are never downgraded

compiler_boundary.native_layer: ICC Plus Local owns pinned native compatibility, validation, serialization, local simulation, explicit native edits, and reference integrity
compiler_boundary.source_compiler: source lowering owns semantic normalization such as Requirement hoisting, style-intent consolidation, taxonomy pruning, Row merging, Pick-N inference, and deterministic runtime-ID compaction/remapping

runtime_serialization.policy: normal saved project JSON and player-facing Viewer payloads omit pinned 2.10.15 fields only when omission is behavior-equivalent; editable project JSON must also preserve the authoring round trip
runtime_serialization.non_sparse_opt_out: all full-project JSON outputs are sparse by default; --not-sparse / --not_sparse is the only opt-out on commands that write project JSON
runtime_serialization.verification_policy: unproven omissions require isolated pinned-Viewer baseline/candidate testing before promotion, plus authoring-round-trip safety for normal project saves

style_policy.group_inheritance: Design Groups may link to normal ICC Plus Groups
style_policy.private_style_guard: one style-manifest item cannot apply private inline styling to multiple targets

agent_contract.normal_saved_project: sparse after successful Creator-complete in-memory validation

official_web_gui_verification.historical_2_10_6: C01 official Creator export exactly matched the retained 2.10.6 round-trip fixture
official_web_gui_verification.browser_authority: official Creator/Viewer remains authoritative for rendering and browser-only behavior
official_web_gui_verification.current_2_10_15: The pinned 2.10.15 official Viewer already passed the 35-case runtime differential, default export and native field metadata checks; the later sparse equivalence suite is subject to its own CI run
